Uses of Interface
io.webagent4j.locator.api.IElementReference

Packages that use IElementReference
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.action.internal
 
io.webagent4j.locator.api
Immutable, backend-neutral locator definitions and the fluent query contracts every semantic search builds on - IFind and ILocator contain no engine logic and no backend-native type.
io.webagent4j.verification
Deterministic, side-effect-free, pollable conditions over current page state - used both as action postconditions (IPreparedAction#expect(...)) and standalone.
